name: schema_pruned_projection
instruction: For oracle diagnostic runs only, use the gold SQL-derived planning hints as hard constraints: choose only the listed relevant tables and columns unless the SQL cannot execute, follow the listed join path, and preserve the projection shape, selected-column order, aggregation outputs, ordering, limit, and duplicate policy.

name: schema_pruned_minimal
instruction: For oracle diagnostic runs only, generate the simplest executable SQLite query that satisfies the current turn and the gold SQL-derived planning hints. Prefer the pruned semantic model, avoid extra joins or selected columns, and keep the selected expressions in the requested order.
